title: Arbutin attenuates CFA-induced arthritis by modulating expression levels of 5-LOX, NF‑kappaB, IL-17, PGE-2 and TNF-alpha.
authors: Sial, Nabeela Tabassum; Malik, Abdul; Iqbal, Urooj; Rehman, Muhammad Fayyaz Ur
one_liner_zh: 该文研究熊果苷对CFA诱导关节炎的抗炎作用，涉及NF-kB等炎症因子表达和分子对接，但核心是药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Arbutin, a naturally soluble glycosylated phenol has antioxidant, antimicrobial, antitumor and anti-inflammatory properties. The current exploration appraises the treatment of arthritis by use of Arbutin (25, 50 and 100 mg/kg) orally in CFA-induced rat arthritis model. Body weight changes, paw size, and joint diameter were recorded till the 28th day in the arthritic-induced rats. Hematological, biochemical, oxidative and inflammatory biomarkers were measured through the blood samples of anesthetized rats. Arbutin markedly decreased paw volume, PGE-2, anti-CCP and 5-LOX levels, however, maintained metabolic and hematological balance and prevented weight loss. Radiology and histology changes improved significantly in the ankle joints of rats. Moreover, Arbutin increased gene pointers such as IL-10 and IL-4 while significantly reducing the levels of CRP and WBCs, whereas Hb, platelets and RBCs count markedly raised in post-treatments. Antioxidant levels of SOD, CAT and GSH were improved and MDA level was reduced in treated groups. Rt-PCR investigation showed a significant reduction of the interleukin-1beta, TNF-alpha, interleukin-6, cyclooxygenase-2, NF-kappaB and IL-17 and increased expression of gene pointers like IL-4, and IL-10 in treated groups. Assessment of molecular docking revealed a strong binding interaction of Arbutin against 5-LOX, IL-17, TNF-alpha and interleukin-6, cyclooxygenase-2, nuclear factor-kappaB, IL-4 and iNOS providing a strong association between experimental and theoretical results. As a result, Arbutin has significantly reduced CFA-induced arthritis by modulation of anti-inflammatory cytokines, i.e., IL-10 and IL-4, the pro-inflammatory cytokines panel such as NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, PGE-2, 5-LOX and COX-2 and oxidative biomarkers.
abstract_zh: 熊果苷（Arbutin）是一种天然可溶性糖基化酚类化合物，具有抗氧化、抗菌、抗肿瘤和抗炎特性。当前研究评估了在CFA诱导的大鼠关节炎模型中口服熊果苷（25、50和100 mg/kg）对关节炎的治疗效果。在关节炎诱导大鼠中，记录体重变化、爪大小和关节直径直至第28天。通过麻醉大鼠的血液样本测量血液学、生化、氧化和炎症生物标志物。熊果苷显著降低了爪体积、PGE-2、抗CCP和5-LOX水平，同时维持了代谢和血液学平衡，并防止了体重减轻。大鼠踝关节的放射学和组织学变化显著改善。此外，熊果苷增加了IL-10和IL-4等基因指标，同时显著降低了CRP和WBCs水平，而治疗后Hb、血小板和RBCs计数显著升高。在治疗组中，SOD、CAT和GSH的抗氧化水平得到改善，MDA水平降低。Rt-PCR研究显示，治疗组中白细胞介素-1beta、TNF-alpha、白细胞介素-6、环氧化酶-2、NF-kappaB和IL-17显著减少，而IL-4和IL-10等基因指标表达增加。分子对接评估显示，熊果苷与5-LOX、IL-17、TNF-alpha和白细胞介素-6、环氧化酶-2、核因子-kappaB、IL-4和iNOS之间存在强结合相互作用，为实验和理论结果提供了强关联。因此，熊果苷通过调节抗炎细胞因子（即IL-10和IL-4）、促炎细胞因子组（如NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6、PGE-2、5-LOX和COX-2）以及氧化生物标志物，显著减轻了CFA诱导的关节炎。
